name: Milvus Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 open-source vector database for semantic, hybrid and full-text search, with standalone Docker and distributed Kubernetes deployment; no vendor-imposed software vector or query quota.
watch_out: Self-hosted edition only; compute, RAM, storage, networking, backups and operations are your responsibility. Zilliz managed cloud is a separate paid/limited service; infrastructure and optional model/embedding API usage may cost money.
